tagline.en_US: Joplin is a free, open source note taking and to-do application, which can handle a large number of notes organised into notebooks.

description.en_US: Joplin is an open source note-taking and to-do application designed to handle large collections of notes. It allows users to structure their content neatly into notebooks and keep track of daily responsibilities. The application serves as a personal workspace for organizing thoughts, research, and task lists.
